payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Papyrus
payload.description:
Low-priority cleanups for the Papyrus repo.

- [ ] README.md has a duplicate `## Commands` heading (lines 91 and 93). Merge or remove one.
- [ ] Dead relative links: publications/threat_intelligence/docs/video-pipeline.md, bootstrap.md, skills/produce-video, the pilobolus father-justin.md reference, skills/newsroom-research-workflow/SKILL.md:29, and docs/archive/priming...:108. Fix the targets or remove the links.
- [ ] docs/python-cli-and-testing.md:25 says "Plexus" ("Newsroom agents use the single-tool Tactus pattern from Plexus."). Plexus was renamed Primus; update the wording.
- [ ] docs/migrations/p-apyr-us.md is a stale cutover handoff. Move to docs/archive or delete.
- [ ] Note: Papyrus develop and main show diverged history (main has 9 merge commits not on develop, no content difference found at audit time). Confirm the next develop -> main promotion is a clean fast-forward.

**How to verify**
`grep -c '^## Commands' README.md` returns 1; a markdown link checker over the repo reports none of the targets above; `grep -n Plexus docs/python-cli-and-testing.md` returns nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
